name: Validate Phone
description: Is this a phone number, and what is it in international E.164 format? Answers { valid, e164, country, national, international } or { valid: false, reason } — for a customer's phone on an invoice, an SMS recipient, a contact form; country (US, GB, IN, SG, …) resolves a number typed without its country code.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= parsed && parsed.isValid() ? { valid: true, e164: parsed.number, country: parsed.country, national: parsed.formatNational(), international: parsed.formatInternational() } : { valid: false, reason: 'Not a phone number' + (country ? ' for ' + country : '') } }}"}]
